activity_summary: You were still in the house, dressed to walk. The shoes were new-soled, the hat was the broad one, and the wallet was on your back. You were leaving the close at ten past four. The cheese stayed shut.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke three lines and left the close.

facets.activity: Dressed to leave the close at ten past four
